rows.label: tlk43200142_06_msg0001
rows.name: I've got an interesting story for you!

rows.label: tlk43200142_06_msg0002
rows.name:
Some Hræsvelgr children saw a giant
fish down at Faaren Waters!

rows.label: tlk43200142_06_msg0003
rows.name:
But the other Merc Groups are all
desperate to catch it too!

rows.label: tlk43200142_06_msg0004
rows.name:
We're the ones who found it. I'd hate
to see another Merc Group catch it!

rows.label: tlk43200142_06_msg0005
rows.name:
Please! Catch the giant fish
before them!
